title: Intraperitoneal Insulin Tolerance Test Protocol
author: Henri Brunengraber
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yefftbn
materials: Return mice to cage with food.

steps.title: Fast mice and transfer
steps.instruction: Fast mice overnight or for 6 hours, then remove each mouse from its home cage and place it into a clean cage containing water but no food.

steps.title: Label mice
steps.instruction: Mark each mouse on its tail with a permanent marker to allow rapid identification.

steps.title: Weigh and calculate insulin dose
steps.instruction: Weigh each mouse, record its weight, and calculate the insulin volume required to deliver 0.75–1.0 U per kilogram body weight; record the calculated injection volume for each mouse.

steps.title: Prepare insulin working solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the insulin stock (100 U · mL⁻¹) with sterile saline or appropriate diluent to a final concentration of 0.1 U · mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Baseline glucose measurement
steps.instruction: Take a blood glucose reading from each mouse and record it as time 0; immediately dip the tail tip into clotisol to clot the blood sample.

steps.title: Inject insulin intraperitoneally
steps.instruction: Inject each mouse intraperitoneally with the calculated volume of the 0.1 U · mL⁻¹ insulin solution, spacing injections 3 minutes apart between mice.

steps.title: Post‑injection glucose readings
steps.instruction: At 15 min, 30 min, and 60 min after the insulin injection, repeat the glucose measurement and dip the tail into clotisol for each mouse, recording each value.
